Hi Samir  quick technical note ahead of the demo:

- Scoped keys / org controls: Redwood supports API keys with scoped permissions and team-level access controls in the Console; for GitHub-based teams we recommend provisioning keys per CI runner or per-repo and rotating them via our key rotation API.
- GitHub App: we dont currently ship a first-class GitHub App; most customers use a lightweight Actions runner that pulls a short-lived token from our key service or injects scoped keys via Actions secrets. We can share a reference workflow during demo.
- Webhooks / callbacks: supported. We provide job-status webhook endpoints and delivery retries; will demo the webhook config and sample payloads.
- Private / VPC: available for enterprise customers; well cover the onboarding and network requirements in the demo.

I attached a short demo deck and an integration checklist you can preview before the call.

Thanks  looking forward to 2:00pm PT today.
